releaseNotes:
Clickerist v1.17.36
Includes improvements and fixes from v1.17.26–v1.17.36.

New features

- Added Marketplace Multi mode: select multiple listings, arrange their priority and try them sequentially.
- Added automatic Marketplace access recovery with configurable retries, restoration notifications and optional tab focus.
- Added Fixed and Random Range refresh options.
- Added ticket price limits to the monitoring live feed.
- Added notification dismissal settings: 5 seconds for routine alerts and 60 seconds for held/reserved tickets by default.
- Added browser-specific Google Drive downloads.
- Added a compact update notice with “What’s new,” Download update and dismissal per version.
- Added automatic update checks on popup open, limited to once every six hours.

Bug fixes

- Fixed Marketplace Multi live-feed flickering.
- Fixed small, misaligned listing-selection checkboxes.
- Fixed Ticketmaster Batch to Pair exceeding 10 tickets.
- Fixed old notification timers potentially clearing newer replacement notifications.
- Fixed cramped “What’s new” notes by moving them into a large dialog with full-width scrollable text, Close, × and Escape controls.
- Prevented F9/F10 ticket-operation shortcuts from triggering while the release-notes dialog is open.

Performance and usability

- Reduced repeated page scans, storage operations and popup redraws.
- Improved category capture and Marketplace listing-matching efficiency.
- Shortened mode descriptions and improved settings order.
- Packaged updates inside a fixed Clickerist folder to help preserve the installation path.
- Allowed Marketplace Turbo intervals down to 1 ms; actual browser timing may be slower.
- Kept the update header compact while reading release notes, with keyboard focus returning after closing the dialog.

Known limitations

- Unexpected Marketplace HTTP 400 responses may still stop clicking.
- Extension installation remains manual.
